title: Students and youth strike in Croatia against living costs and war
seoTitle: Zagreb youth strike and anti-war protest

tea.why: High living costs, difficult housing access, and concerns over education, health, environment, and war.
tea.want: Demilitarization, better environmental protection, affordable housing, transparency, and action on youth issues.
tea.changed: Nov 20, 2026: Organizers reported a higher turnout than expected while the Education Minister warned of unexcused absences.

summary: High school and university students across Croatia launched a day-long strike and class boycott as part of the International Youth Strike movement. Protest activities were announced in cities including Zagreb, Rijeka, Pula, Zadar, and Osijek. The initiative, organized by the Štrajk mladih group under the slogan for our future and against their wars, aims to highlight high living costs, inaccessible housing, education and health challenges, environmental protection, and demilitarization. Organizers stated that turnout exceeded expectations and that participants will not stop after the boycott. In response, Minister of Science and Education Radovan Fuchs labeled the participants anarchists engaged in politicization and announced unexcused absences for students missing school, while defending existing student rights and living measures.
response: Education Minister Radovan Fuchs described the protesters as anarchists involved in politicization, announced unexcused absences for absent students, and stated that current student measures and prices are adequate.

updates.text: Students and high schoolers across Croatia held a day-long strike and boycott organised by Štrajk mladih.
Minister Radovan Fuchs criticized the action and announced unexcused absences for participants.
